# Layer 2 — Genre Frames

Frames are **recipes**, not engines.

Each Frame supplies:
- standard menu flow
- standard mode definitions
- default stat keys
- default challenge categories
- useful settings/accessibility defaults
- module recommendations

## Arcade / Score Attack
Core loop: play → score → result → retry.
Expected: score, combo, time, medals, leaderboard seam, instant retry.

## Character Action
Expected: mission select, rank/grade, difficulty, training, technique/challenge trials, encounter/result flow.

## Arena Combat
Expected: fighter/loadout select, arena select, round/match rules, bots, training, rematch.

## Vehicle / Racing / Stunt
Expected: vehicle/garage, event select, time/score modes, ghosts/replays seam, tuning/loadout.

## FPS / Traversal Shooter
Expected: campaign/challenge stage select, sensitivity/FOV, mouse lock, checkpoints, combat/traversal trials.

## Puzzle / Stage-Based
Expected: stage select, completion grade, hints/assists, best result, challenge variants.

## RPG / Progression
Expected: progression, inventory/equipment/economy modules, objectives, dialogue seam, save/profile depth.

## Strategy / Tower Defense
Expected: mission/wave state, speed controls, pause, loadout/deck, objective variants, post-run results.

## Platformer / Movement
Expected: stage select, checkpoints, time/medals, quick retry, practice segments.

## Party / Multiplayer
Expected: player join/leave, controller assignment, ruleset, map/stage select, local profile seam.
